Hyundai Sales Breakup Oct 2026 - Creta, Venue, Exter, Aura, i20, i10, Bayon, Verna, Alcazar

KS
By Kabir Sharma Indian Automotive & SUV Specialist • via Rushlane.com Wire
⚡ Visual Story
Source & Photography: Rushlane.com Wire Dispatch Verified Editorial Asset
⚡ Executive Takeaways & Key Highlights
  • Hyundai Motor India sold 62,799 units in October 2026, up from 53,792 units in October last year and 57,166 units in September 2026.
  • The company added 9,007 units year-on-year and 5,633 units month-on-month.
  • The new Bayon appeared in Hyundai’s monthly sales chart for the first time with 3,449 units, while Venue set a monthly record with 13,017 units.
⚡ EDITORIAL TAKE • KABIR SHARMA Indian Automotive & SUV Specialist

Bharat NCAP Safety Standards & Indian Road Readiness

In India's rapidly evolving automotive landscape, crashworthiness and real-world durability are driving consumer purchase decisions like never before. As reported by Rushlane.com, indigenous automakers like Tata Motors and Mahindra are setting global safety benchmarks while optimizing suspension and ground clearance for unpredictable road conditions.

Big Picture: Upcoming monthly FADA retail delivery reports and Bharat NCAP rating scorecards will reveal which domestic models capture mass-market dominance.

Hyundai Motor India sold 62,799 units in October 2026, up from 53,792 units in October last year and 57,166 units in September 2026. The company added 9,007 units year-on-year and 5,633 units month-on-month. The new Bayon appeared in Hyundai’s monthly sales chart for the first time with 3,449 units, while Venue set a monthly record with 13,017 units. Together, the two SUVs accounted for nearly 89% of Hyundai’s volume gain over September.

📌 The Core Development

Creta, including the Creta Electric, led Hyundai’s lineup with 17,955 units. Sales were down 2.32% from 18,381 units in October 2025 but up 1.69% from 17,657 units in September 2026. Creta accounted for 28.59% of Hyundai’s October sales and finished 4,938 units ahead of Venue.

Venue’s record tally of 13,017 units was up 10.90% from 11,738 units a year earlier and 13.53% from 11,466 units in September. It added 1,551 units over the previous month, the biggest gain among Hyundai models with September sales. Creta and Venue together sold 30,972 units, accounting for just over 49% of Hyundai’s October volumes.

🔍 Background & Sector Context

Exter took third place with 8,509 units, up 35.19% from 6,294 units a year earlier and 1.98% from 8,344 units in September. Its year-on-year gain of 2,215 units was the largest among Hyundai models with sales in October 2025. Aura finished fourth with 7,349 units. The compact sedan gained 26.38% YoY from 5,815 units, although sales slipped 2.40% from 7,530 units in September.

The i20 ranked fifth with 5,528 units, up 37.41% YoY and 1.88% MoM. It recorded the highest year-on-year percentage growth in Hyundai’s lineup, adding 1,505 units over October 2025. Grand i10 Nios finished just 70 units behind with 5,458 units. Its sales rose 0.59% from 5,426 units a year earlier and 4.36% from 5,230 units in September.

📊 Industry & Real-World Impact

The newly launched Bayon entered the chart in seventh place with 3,449 units, giving it a 5.49% share of Hyundai’s October sales. Its first month on the chart accounted for more than 61% of the company’s month-on-month volume gain. Together with Creta, Hyundai as recorded 21,404 mid-size SUV sales in Oct. Hyundai aims to sell 2.5 lakh mid-size SUVs .

🔮 Strategic Outlook & What Lies Ahead

Verna took eighth place with 775 units, down 5.95% from 824 units a year earlier and up 1.71% from 762 units in September. Alcazar followed just 17 units behind at 758 units. The three-row SUV grew 2.16% MoM from 742 units, while sales fell 39.79% YoY from 1,259 units.

Hyundai sold one Ioniq 5 in October, compared with six units a year earlier and nine in September. Tucson is no longer on sale in India. With Bayon joining the lineup, Hyundai had six models above 5,000 units and seven above 3,000 units in October.
